premise: Milo was built to collect rubbish. He now chooses what to keep and learns to care for it. His collection slowly becomes a home.
principles: Reveal his former work through habits before explaining it.
Every chapter leaves a tangible object or visible change in the space.
Keep the plant and visiting moth central; living visitors are never possessions.
Make reactions visibly match player actions. Use simple objectives, no inventory dashboard.
Shelter emerges from found materials and his care for the collection. Milo also stays dry.
The player supports Milo's choices; he gradually acts without asking permission.

actions: Watch him put the cap safely inside
chapters.lastingChange: An open keepsake box and his first blue cap beside the garden.
dialogue: I’d like to keep this one.

actions: Find each part using cursor light
Rotate keyed parts and fit them together
Test the fan and discover the bent grille
Switch the fan on and sit in its breeze
chapters.lastingChange: A repaired desk fan with an interactive switch; its breeze moves the plant.

chapters.action: Turn it together, discover the intact side, plant a second seed inside.
chapters.lastingChange: A cup planter, with the chip still visible.

chapters.action: Guide his arm to tap the can, cup and box. Each contact makes a distinct sound and visible reaction. No drawing or imitation puzzle.
chapters.lastingChange: A spoon kept next to the watering can.

chapters.action: Let Milo arrange the button and cap; the player helps move a box into place.
chapters.lastingChange: His first arrangement of things he likes.

chapters.action: Hold and fit pieces while he assembles a small shelf. Items move onto it one at a time.
chapters.lastingChange: Shelves and boxes forming a lived-in corner.

chapters.action: Help repair it; keep the repair visible.
chapters.lastingChange: An object with an obvious, affectionate repair.

chapters.action: Make a roof above Milo and his shelves. Leave the plant where it can enjoy the rain, with a dry spot for the moth.
chapters.lastingChange: Shelter for Milo and the objects he cares for.

chapters.action: Connect the instructions to the collection reflex seen earlier. Milo decides to care for his finds instead.
chapters.ending: A quiet home to return to: tend plants, inspect finds, tap objects, move his arms or sit together.
